disclaimer: This generator provides templates for reference only. Please consult a legal professional to ensure full GDPR compliance for your specific situation.
detailed_description: GDPR Consent Generator creates customizable cookie consent banners and privacy policy templates that comply with European data protection regulations. Generate ready-to-use HTML and CSS code for your website, with options for different cookie types, banner positions, and themes.
usage_steps: Enter your website and company information
Select which cookie types your website uses
Copy the generated HTML and CSS code
Customize the privacy policy template for your needs
usage_examples: Add GDPR-compliant cookie consent to websites
Create privacy policy documents for EU compliance
Implement cookie preference management for users
